policiesConsulted.name: Roblox Terms of Use (User and Creator Terms; current text, page updated 2026-10-07; revision effective 2026-11-01)
Roblox is Updating our Terms of Use (2026-11-01 revision)

conditions: Creator Terms (AI Technologies & AI Tools; also 2026-11-01 revision section 5) require Creators using Third-Party Services that include AI technologies to give Users clear in-experience disclosure that the AI is not human and that AI output is artificially generated. The voices are ElevenLabs AI speech and no in-experience disclosure was found in src/. Upload is approved; before these banks are made audible (merge of PR #161), the experience must show such a disclosure. The same gap already applies to the live banks on main.

voiceBank01.method: Independent manual review of all 168 exact and spoken transcript lines and all 168 cached STT heard strings for moderation (profanity, slurs, sexual content, personal info, real people/brands, copied Ace Combat dialogue/names, all-ages fictional combat), against the Roblox Terms of Use, Community Standards, audio asset guidelines and Audio Upload License Agreement as fetched 2026-10-30T04:05-04:12Z. SHA-256 recomputed and matched to upload-plan.json, stt.json and checklist; .ogg bytes unchanged since a8d9ab4. Bank membership, VoiceCues.ts regions/text, RelayStory.ts subtitles (122 lines) and story-script.json (168 rows) all agree with transcripts.json. Per-region RMS confirms speech in every region; integrated loudness -16.2 LUFS, peaks <= -0.6 dBFS; Ogg Vorbis mono 44.1 kHz, under 6.5 min and 20 MB. All 16 cast voice ids recorded as premade in the cached /v1/voices category evidence (8 used); all 168 provenance cacheKeys recomputed from casting, raw take SHA-256s and requestIds match the generation cache, every generation request text equals the spoken text, tier starter. STT scores re-derived (tools/voice.py stt-offline reproduces stt.json exactly) and cross-checked with an independent word-LCS recall; all 30 lines with any heard-text difference inspected and every sub-90% line compared word for word. Text + STT + casting evidence review only: no human listened to any bank or sampler.
